nodes.label: Concept assembly, mm. +X front, +Z up, ground Z=0. 4600 length, 2700 wheelbase, 1560 track. Physical longitudinal cutaway, not transparency. All chassis groups retained from successive assembly saves. Flat sections are a faceted loft approximation, not Class-A production surfacing.

backend.name: Open-MBEE SysML v2
backend.license: Apache-2.0 AND EPL-2.0 (bundled OMG standard library)
backend.standardLibrary: bundled OMG SysML v2 / KerML, EPL-2.0

limitations: Checks use the Open-MBEE toolkit supported syntax, resolution and semantic rule inventory; this is not complete OMG conformance certification.

The semantic kernel does not execute SysML behaviors or NOS3 simulation. Continuous FMI execution is a separate professional job: OpenSysML evaluates the SysML analysis verdict, FMPy supplies the plotted FMU trajectory, and neither establishes physical correctness.
Unresolved referential findings fail the Daidalis acceptance gate even when the upstream toolkit labels them warnings.
